title: Worst Man
overview: When a 40-year old Best Man throws a bachelor party for his newly divorced friend, taking matters into his own hands may lead to chaos, grief, and the potential bankruptcy of their sports bar. Proving that while it's the Best Man's job to get you to the altar, it's the Worst Man's job to get you through your divorce.

trailers.title: “Worst Man" Short Film (Jason Earles, Chris Van Vliet, James Storm) Beverly Hills Film Festival 2026
